Eli: Heads-up: noticed systematic delta where invoice_preview > final invoices for ~30 tenants in preview cohort. Percent delta ~12% median. Sample tenant: 'orbit-inc'.

Maya: Any common signal? preview uses aggregated partials, final uses raw-event replay.

Eli: Quick triage: preview aggregates include entries labeled model_alias='gptx-4-small' while final billing tokenization used model_sku='gptx-4-small-quant'. Token factors differ ~0.8 vs 1.0 leading to lower final. But preview shows the higher tokenization before normalization.

Raj: So the mismatch is model alias normalization happening at billing-time but not in preview path? Which service normalizes?

Taylor: router-normalizer v3.2.0 started canonicalizing model_alias and also strips vendor postfix. Deployed 2026-04-02 01:12 UTC by ci-bot.

ci-bot: Deployed router-normalizer v3.2.0 @2026-04-02T01:12Z. Change: canonicalize model_alias; remove postfixes like '-quant' for routing consistency.

Maya: If router strips '-quant' then preview's aggregator (which reads pre-normalized event attrs) still captured the original alias, but billing later uses normalized sku mapping -> that would produce token factor mismatch - but reversed direction from Eli's note.

Eli: Right. Example events: edge_event shows model_requested='gptx-4' model_served='gptx-4-small-quant' tokens_req=200 tokens_resp=600 -> preview aggregate recorded model_alias_raw='gptx-4-small-quant' -> preview tokens_preview=800 with token_factor 1.0. Final billing mapping normalized alias to 'gptx-4-small' and applied factor 0.8 -> final tokens=640, so preview > final by 160.

Raj: Okay makes sense. Why would preview be using raw alias while final uses normalized alias? Aren't both consumers of the same event stream?

Taylor: Preview pipeline reads the edge stream before router-normalizer enrichment. Final billing reads the normalized stream from the enrichment topic. We made that choice for latency but forgot to keep tokenization mapping consistent.

Maya: Two possible fixes: 1) change preview to use normalized alias topic OR 2) update the billing SKU mapping to include fallback aliases mapping raw->normalized factors so both paths converge.

Eli: Prefer #2 short-term (cheaper risk), #1 long-term (consistency). Also need to record in console which alias the preview used vs final used on the invoice preview page.

Raj: Agree. For reconciliation, we need to find preview windows (2026-04-02T00:00..2026-04-03T06:00) where model_alias_raw != model_alias_normalized and compute delta by tenant.

Maya: I'll open BILL-3432 and attach query + CSV of tenants. Also propose a targeted preview recompute using normalized alias mapping for those windows so preview reflects final.

Eli: We should also add an alert: preview_vs_final_token_delta_pct > 5% for 30m for any tenant with >1000 tokens.

Taylor: I'll add a contract test in router-normalizer CI: publish normalized_alias and also write canonical_alias into header 'X-Canonical-Model' so downstreams have consistent field name.

ci-bot: Created BILL-3432: "preview/final alias mismatch and reconciliation" assigned to @Maya. Link: https://billing.redwood/tickets/BILL-3432

Raj: For reconciliation plan: (A) update sku_map with alias synonyms mapping raw->quant factor; (B) run preview recompute for affected tenants windows; (C) if recompute changes invoice_preview >10% for paid customers, ops to send notification.

Maya: I'm running query now:
```
SELECT tenant_id, SUM(preview_tokens) as preview_tokens, SUM(final_tokens) as final_tokens
FROM preview.vs_final_joined
WHERE window BETWEEN '2026-04-02T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-03T06:00:00Z'
  AND preview_model_alias != final_model_alias
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY preview_tokens - final_tokens DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

Maya: CSV attached to BILL-3432 (42 tenants).

Eli: Good. Maya please also include a sample event_id per tenant so we can audit line-level.

Raj: After sku_map alias update, we should re-run invoice_preview generator only (no final billing touch) to avoid touching committed invoices. Keep backfill scoped to preview metrics shown in console.

Taylor: Dev plan: router-normalizer -> add header, add schema to normalized topic, add integration test. Deploy patch to canary within 6 hours.

Maya: Action items posted in BILL-3432: (1) sku_map alias patch (billing) (2) preview recompute job scoped to CSV windows (3) console UI change to show preview vs final alias and tokenization factor (4) alert rule.

Eli: One more ask: add a debug flag in preview recompute to produce per-event diff so we can create a short audit file for customer's support team if needed.

Maya: will do. Starting work now, will update ticket with job run ETA.
